header.title: School Radio
header.subtitle: Upload audio and schedule playback to the building's speakers.
header.scheduledPlaybacksTooltip: Upcoming and past playbacks in one window

netradio.description: Scroll through the list, pick the station and — if available — a substream, then press ▶. You can change the target and stream URLs below, or with the Edit button.
netradio.emptyList: The radio list is empty – use the "Restore defaults" button.
netradio.exportTooltip: Saves the current list to a .json file
netradio.setDefaultTooltip: Every new user of this institution will see this list first
netradio.restoreTooltip: The list resets to the initial 16 stations (custom entries are lost)
netradio.footerHint: It's worth checking substream URLs on myonlineradio.hu. The list is stored in the browser (per institution and device)
netradio.footerHintAdminSuffix: – use the ⭐ button to make it the default for the whole institution.

library.uploadPrompt: Drag a file here or click to upload

playTooltip.playing: Now playing – press again to restart
playTooltip.idle: Play now (on the currently selected target)

schedule.immediateTooltip: The file plays right away, no date/time needed

playlist.title: Playlist builder
playlist.emptyHint: Add tracks from the other tabs
playlist.uploadToListButton: Upload a sound file to the list
playlist.youtubeUrlHint: Paste a YouTube video link. Title and duration load automatically.
playlist.googleDriveHint: Paste a Google Drive file or folder link. Sound files are listed automatically.
playlist.recordingHint: Record a spoken segment and add it to the playlist. The recording is uploaded to the library and appended to the end of the list.
playlist.recordingStartHint: Click the button to start recording.
playlist.recordingDoneHint: Recording ready – give it a listen!

stationModal.needAtLeastOneStream: At least one stream is required
stationModal.myonlineradioHint: You can check public stream URLs and sub-channels on myonlineradio.hu.
